title: Best Task/ToDo app I've tried
body: I love this app, I've tried so many task apps, but this one just has everything I need. You can make habits, tasks, recurring events/tasks and set reminders for all of them. The only downside is that there’s a maximum habits(2 habits) if you don’t pay subscription, but that’s fair enough. I think the maximum should be 3 habits instead, but if you’re willing to pay some money for a fantastic task app, then the app is perfect for you.
